title: K01 Configuration and revision policy
rules: Any engineering change to a RELEASED artifact creates a new revision/controlled successor; in-place editing is prohibited.
Each baseline records the exact set of controlled artifact IDs plus hashes/revisions.
Rejected alternatives remain in decision history and are never deleted to make the baseline appear cleaner.
Configuration status accounting reports current, superseded and open-change states for every controlled configuration item.
A promotion is an explicit baseline transition, not a file copy alone.
Native CAD revision history belongs in a CAD-aware vault/PDM once multi-user SW2026 operation begins; Git remains authoritative for text/code/control artifacts.

review_vocabulary.SRR: System Requirements Review — requirements sufficiently defined to proceed.
review_vocabulary.PDR: Preliminary Design Review — architecture and major interfaces are credible; major risks understood.
review_vocabulary.CDR: Critical Design Review — detailed design definition and analyses support fabrication/release preparation.
review_vocabulary.TRR: Test Readiness Review — test article, procedure, instrumentation and acceptance criteria are ready.
review_vocabulary.PRR: Production/Release Readiness Review — product definition, BOM, process, inspection, evidence and configuration baseline are ready for release.
